T-1 Pre-Print Expectations

Consensus called for $147.85M in Q3 revenue (+0.8% YoY) and -$0.02 in non-GAAP EPS. Buy-side whisper was $150.50M. Options priced a ±22.0% swing ($14.20 straddle) around the commercial launch of Atera and academic spending headwinds.

T+0 Delivery: Top-Line Beat & Guidance Raise vs EPS Miss

10x delivered $150.67M in revenue (+1.91% vs consensus), gross margins expanded to 74.95%, and management raised FY26 revenue guidance to $625M-$635M ($630M midpoint). However, non-GAAP EPS missed (-$0.15 vs -$0.02) and instruments fell -42.8% YoY to $6.86M.

T-1 Thesis Verdict: RESILIENT MULTIOMIC CONSUMABLES WITH AI UPSIDE

Consumables reached $134.33M (+5.0% YoY) and OCF rose to $25.25M. The introduction of Sentira with NVIDIA and Anthropic positions 10x as an AI-native life sciences platform, cushioning near-term instrument softness with $575.7M in liquid reserves.

Forensic Cash Quality & Balance Sheet Fortress Assessment

10x Genomics demonstrated notable cash conversion in Q3 2026, generating Operating Cash Flow of $25.25M and Reported Free Cash Flow of $23.65M. Even after fully deducting $23.10M in non-cash stock-based compensation, Forensic True Free Cash Flow crossed into positive territory at +$0.55M.

• Liquidity Moat: Total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities reached $575.68M ($575.7M) as of September 30, 2026, providing an unassailable financial cushion with zero long-term funded debt.
• Sequential Cash Build: Liquid cash resources increased by +$23.65M during the third quarter, fully self-funding operations without outside financing.
• Sustained Capital Discipline: CapEx remained ultra-low at $1.60M (1.1% of revenue), underscoring the scalable, asset-light leverage of 10x's manufacturing infrastructure.
• Litigation Settlement Reserves: Prior legal settlements and gain recognitions provide clear operational runway free of injunction overhangs.
Row 4: Operational Wins, Drags & Earnings Call Q&A Audit
QUALITATIVE & TRANSCRIPT FORENSICS

Operational Wins & Catalysts

  • Atera Global Commercial Launch: Began commercial shipments of the high-throughput Atera spatial biology platform with extraordinary customer demand across discovery and biopharma research.
  • Sentira Cloud AI Platform: Unveiled Sentira in partnership with NVIDIA (accelerated spatial image processing) and Anthropic (Claude-powered agentic multiomic analysis), launching an AI software ecosystem.
  • Consumables Revenue Growth: High-margin consumables revenue climbed +5.0% YoY to $134.33M, proving recurring research demand despite capital procurement softness.
  • FY 2026 Guidance Raise: Raised full-year revenue outlook to $625M - $635M ($630.0M midpoint), implying strong Q4 acceleration toward ~$175.0M.

Execution Drags & Watch Items

  • Bottom-Line EPS Miss: Non-GAAP EPS missed Street expectations (-$0.15 vs -$0.02) due to elevated legal defense costs and commercialization investments.
  • Severe Instrument Contraction: Instrument placements fell -42.8% YoY to $6.86M as academic research grant delays constrained institutional capital spending.
  • Post-Earnings Multiple Compression: TXG stock fell -9.73% to $52.41 in after-hours trading as investors digested the bottom-line shortfall.
  • GEM-X Migration Timing: Ongoing customer transitions to GEM-X single-cell assays created localized inventory digestion before anticipated volume ramp.
Top Institutional Analyst Q&A and Analyst Questions Forensic Exchanges
Tycho Peterson (Jefferies) — Atera Commercial Launch Velocity & Instrument Capex Headwinds

Question: Can you describe the early customer uptake for Atera following the initial commercial shipments? Are researchers substituting existing Xenium placements or expanding into net new spatial budgets?

Executive Answer: Serge Saxonov (CEO): 'Atera demand has been extraordinary. What we are seeing is not cannibalization of Xenium, but rather opening up high-throughput translational and biopharma programs that previously could not access subcellular spatial resolution at this scale. While broader instrument capital spending across academic labs remains constrained, Atera represents a must-have system for data-maximalist research.'

Forensic Assessment: NET NEW BUDGET CONVERSION
Dan Arias (Stifel) — Gross Margin Resilience & Mix Progression Toward 75%

Question: Gross margin reached 74.95%, up nearly 765 basis points YoY. How sustainable is this mid-70s gross margin as Atera instrument volume ramps against consumables?

Executive Answer: Justin McAnear (CFO): 'The gross margin strength this quarter was powered by lower inventory charges, manufacturing efficiency gains in our microfluidic consumables, and a 89% consumables revenue mix. Even as Atera instrument shipments ramp in Q4, the high consumable pull-through per installed instrument gives us confidence that our structural gross margins will remain firmly in the mid-70s.'

Forensic Assessment: MID-70s GROSS MARGIN CONFIRMED
Tejas Savant (Morgan Stanley) — Sentira Cloud AI Platform & Monetization with NVIDIA / Claude

Question: How will Sentira be commercialized? Does the integration with NVIDIA accelerated computing and Anthropic Claude create a software ARR subscription stream?

Executive Answer: Serge Saxonov (CEO): 'Sentira addresses the biggest bottleneck in biology today: extracting biological truth from massive, complex spatial datasets. By partnering with NVIDIA for accelerated spatial image processing and Anthropic for agentic Claude reasoning across single-cell multiomics, we are transforming 10x into an end-to-end biological intelligence platform. We will monetize Sentira through compute tiers and enterprise SaaS subscriptions.'
